<p class="owner"><span class="en">Author: Christine (Kuntong) Jiang</span><span class="zh">作者：江坤彤</span></p>

## [Terms]{.en}[术语]{.zh}

::: {.en}
::: tw
| English | Chinese | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| Waste-to-energy (WtE) | 垃圾焚烧发电 | Burning residual waste to make power and heat |
| Cap licence | 配额许可 | Victorian licence for thermal WtE tonnes under the 2.5 Mt/yr cap |
| Existing-operator licence | 既有运营商许可 | Licence for facilities that pre-date the cap scheme |
| Operation and maintenance (O&M) | 运营管理 | Running a plant for its owner under contract |
| Gate fee / tipping fee | 进场处理费 / 垃圾处理费 | Fee per tonne of waste received ("gate fee" in Australia, "tipping fee" in China) |
| Lower heating value (LHV) | 低位热值 | Usable heat per kilogram of waste |
| CEMS | 烟气在线监测系统 | Continuous stack emissions monitoring |
| FOGO | 食物和园林有机垃圾分类 | Food organics and garden organics kerbside collection |
| Red-bin garbage | 红桶垃圾 | Household general waste from the red-lid kerbside bin; the feedstock for WtE |
| TEEP test | 技术、环境、经济可行性测试 | Proof that commercial waste cannot practicably be recycled before it is burnt |
| Pattern approval | 计量型式批准 | NMI approval for a meter type used in trade |
| BOT / BOO | 建设-运营-移交 / 建设-拥有-运营 | Concession models used in China |
| SASAC | 国资委 | State-owned assets supervisor |
| FIRB | 外国投资审查委员会 | Reviews foreign investment; an SOE needs approval to start an Australian business |
| SOCI Act | 关键基础设施安全法 | Security duties for owners of critical water and energy assets |
| Outbound investment filing (ODI) | 境外投资备案 | China-side filings (NDRC, MOFCOM, SAFE) before investing abroad |
| TAM / SAM / SOM | 总/可服务/可获得市场 | Total, serviceable and obtainable market |
:::
:::

::: {.zh}
::: tw
| 中文 | 英文 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| 垃圾焚烧发电 | Waste-to-energy (WtE) | 焚烧剩余垃圾以生产电力和热能 |
| 配额许可 | Cap licence | 维州250万吨/年上限内的热处理焚烧发电许可 |
| 既有运营商许可 | Existing-operator licence | 适用于配额制度实施前已有设施的许可 |
| 运营管理 | Operation and maintenance (O&M) | 根据合同为业主运营电厂 |
| 进场处理费 / 垃圾处理费 | Gate fee / tipping fee | 每吨垃圾的接收费用（澳洲称gate fee，中国称垃圾处理费） |
| 低位热值 | Lower heating value (LHV) | 每千克垃圾的可用热量 |
| 烟气在线监测系统 | CEMS | 烟囱排放连续监测系统 |
| 食物和园林有机垃圾分类 | FOGO | 厨余与园林有机垃圾的路边分类收集 |
| 红桶垃圾 | Red-bin garbage | 澳洲家庭一般垃圾（红盖路边垃圾桶），即焚烧发电的原料 |
| 技术、环境、经济可行性测试 | TEEP test | 证明工商业垃圾在焚烧前无法合理回收 |
| 计量型式批准 | Pattern approval | NMI对用于贸易结算的水表型号的批准 |
| 建设-运营-移交 / 建设-拥有-运营 | BOT / BOO | 中国采用的特许经营模式 |
| 国资委 | SASAC | 国有资产监督管理机构 |
| 外国投资审查委员会 | FIRB | 审查外国投资；国企在澳洲开展新业务需获批准 |
| 关键基础设施安全法 | SOCI Act | 关键水务和能源资产所有者的安全义务 |
| 境外投资备案 | Outbound investment filing (ODI) | 境外投资前须向发改委、商务部、外汇局办理的国内备案 |
| 总/可服务/可获得市场 | TAM / SAM / SOM | 总潜在市场、可服务市场和可获得市场 |
:::
:::

## [Evidence labels]{.en}[证据标签]{.zh} {#evidence-labels}

::: {.en}
::: tw
| Label | Meaning |
|---|---|
| \[Official\] | Government, regulator or parliament record |
| \[Industry\] | Industry report, company announcement or media |
| \[Company\] | CDEG's own material, not independently verified |
| \[Inferred\] | Our own calculation, model output or judgement from the sources |
| \[Assumption\] | A planning value chosen by the team, to be replaced with data |
| [to verify]{.verify} | Incomplete or conflicting; needs checking |
:::
:::

::: {.zh}
::: tw
| 标签 | 含义 |
|---|---|
| \[官方\] | 政府、监管机构或议会记录 |
| \[行业\] | 行业报告、公司公告或媒体 |
| \[企业\] | 集团自有资料，未经独立核实 |
| \[推断\] | 团队根据资料作出的计算、模型结果或判断 |
| \[假设\] | 团队设定的规划值，待以数据替换 |
| [待核实]{.verify} | 信息不完整或相互矛盾，需要核查 |
:::
:::
